chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad al-Kulayni, from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Nawfali, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Accursed is the one who copulates with an animal'.

key_terms.مَلْعُونٌ: Cursed (one who is under divine curse)
key_terms.نَكَحَ: Copulated with / Married (used here for sexual intercourse)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on copulating with an animal in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith establishes the ruling of 'mal'oon' (cursed) for bestiality, serving as a foundational text in Shia jurisprudence. It highlights the severity of the sin by linking human sexual misconduct with the behavior of beasts, a concept further elaborated in Tafsir al-Ayyashi regarding the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah. The narration underscores the deviation from natural human order, a key theme in Shia ethical teachings.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Al Kulayni, from Salih Bin Abu Hammad, from Muhammad Bin Ibrahim Al Nowfaly, from Al Husayn Bin Al Mukhtar, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Accursed is the one who copulates with an animal’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn al-Rayyan who has said the following: “A man once wrote to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and asked about a man who is with a woman and touches her from behind her clothes and his clothes and moves until he discharges semen; if it is like masturbation. He (the Imam) signed the answer that said, ‘In it he has reached his goal (of a sinful act).”’
